provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized bicycle at m=331, a prime with ord_2(m)=30, so the nontrivial cyclotomic cosets of 2 all have size 30. The divisor g is one such coset's minimal polynomial, of degree 31, which fixes k = 2 deg g = 62 by construction. The pair (a,b) was then drawn from the ideal (g) by information-set decoding over sparse supports, keeping weights 10 and 10; both are odd, so x+1 does not divide the gcd and no weight-m block logical is forced. H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)] and H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T] on n = 2m = 662 qubits at uniform row weight 20, with a = [49, 50, 85, 115, 181, 182, 248, 278, 313, 314] and b = [14, 34, 55, 80, 89, 103, 151, 161, 162, 281].
provenance.notes: Distance is an upper bound from the lighter of two witnesses, weight 93 on X and 95 on Z, both carried in this file. A 24-seed randomized information-set search at 2,000,000 trials per seed spread 93 to 101 with the minimum found by one seed. A single run of 8,000,000 trials, matching the verifier's own depth, reads 98. A search restricted to logicals supported inside one circulant block, which a general search is blind to, found nothing below 107. Folding onto the x^t-invariant subspaces leaves a lightest surviving logical of weight 242. The design point is deg g / m = 0.094.
